title: 10 Best Capsella Bursa-Pastoris Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Capsella bursa-pastoris are teas, decoctions, mucillages, poultices, and tinctures, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas are commonly made by steeping the dried leaves and seeds in hot water, promoting digestive health and respiratory relief. Decoctions involve boiling the herb for a longer period, enhancing the extraction of its active compounds. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s gelatinous seeds, are used to soothe irritated tissues and aid in digestion. Poultices, made by crushing fresh leaves, are applied externally to reduce inflammation and promote healing. Tinctures, prepared with alcohol, provide a concentrated form for internal use, supporting immune and urinary functions.
